item.content:encoded:
Love Horoscope Today, October 7, 2026
The love horoscope for October 7, 2026, highlights a day of emotional connections, romantic opportunities, and meaningful conversations across all zodiac signs
Love Horoscope Today, October 7, 2026: Today’s love horoscope brings a heartfelt day filled with emotional connections, meaningful conversations, and romantic opportunities. Aries, Cancer, and Pisces may find it easy to enjoy deep emotional connections and harmony, while Taurus and Virgo may need to relieve tension with honest conversations. Gemini, Libra, and Scorpio are advised to strengthen relationships through communication and self-awareness.
Leo and Capricorn should be cautious about emotions, but will find progress in love through openness and peace. Sagittarius is in for a blissful, romantic time, and Aquarius may experience a special evening that will strengthen love and bring family approval. Overall, it’s a day to connect, listen, and follow your heart.
Aries Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that you have to rely on your intuition to understand your partner’s feelings. Your partner will understand your feelings, and you will get a chance to connect with him/her. You will have deep feelings for your partner, and you will try to express your love in words. Today, your relationship will be quite stable, and you will get a chance to plan your future with your partner.
Taurus Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that your spouse may have a big problem with you, which you may have to face to save your relationship. You may have to talk to your love and speak your heart out to understand their feelings. Today can be quite challenging for you, but you will get time to improve your love and relationship.
Gemini Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today you should spend more time with your partner and share your feelings with them. Today, your relationship will deepen, and there may be more ups and downs in your love relationship. You should maintain communication with your partner and listen to what they say. Today is the time for you to strengthen your relationship with your partner.
Cancer Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that you will be able to understand your love and will be successful in expressing your love. Today, you will get a chance to spend more time with your love, and you will give more importance to your love. Today will be a very precious day for you, and you will get a lot of love from your loved ones. Today will be a memorable day for you, and you will try to keep your love even happier.
Leo Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today, you may have to be a little careful about your love life. You should try to understand yourself, and also try to understand your partner. You have to spend some time on your love life and try to understand him. But today is the day for you to speak your heart openly to strengthen your relationship.
Virgo Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today you will have a great desire to take care of your family, and you will yearn to spend time with your family. But today, there may be some minor disagreement in your love life. If you do not try to solve it, it can become a big problem for you. So be honest in your behavior and try to understand your partner. Today you may have time to talk to your partner.
Libra Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that you should try to maintain communication with your partner and clarify your problems. Mutual understanding will increase in your relationship, and you will realize the true importance of your love. Some challenges may come in married life from the side of the children. You should also try to spend more time with your partner and share your thoughts.
Scorpio Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that you will be able to express your feelings well and understand your importance with your partner. You should try to move your relationship forward by forgetting your ego. Today, you may also get a proposal, about which you may be confused whether to say yes or no. But you should listen to your heart and do what you feel is right.
Sagittarius Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that you should spend a romantic evening with your boyfriend/girlfriend. You should spend some beautiful moments of your life with your boyfriend/girlfriend. Today, you will get the happiness of your love in return for your love. You should go on a great movie date with your boyfriend/girlfriend or go on a short trip. This time will be full of love and romance for you.
Capricorn Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that if you want to get married, then today is the best day for you. There can be a new beginning in your life, and today will probably be a good day for family relationships. But today, do not argue with anyone unnecessarily and try to strengthen your relationship with your spouse.
Aquarius Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that this evening you can go out to eat with your spouse. Today, you can realize the importance of your relationships and get a chance to understand the importance of your love. Today will be a very special day for your love life, and you can get approval for your love from your family. Today will be a very auspicious day for you to express your love.
Pisces Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today you will get to hear many loving things from your spouse, which will touch your heart. Today you will get many romantic moments with your spouse, and both of you will be able to understand each other better. Today, you can also be proposed, but before making any decision, you should listen to your heart and do what you feel is right.
Quick Answers
Sagittarius is expected to have a blissful and romantic time on October 7, 2026, while Aquarius may experience a special evening that strengthens love and earns family approval.

item.title: [Phys.org] The ick: The psychology of why a romantic partner can suddenly repulse you
item.dc:creator: Rachael Leggett
item.description: The ick: The psychology of why a romantic partner can suddenly repulse you Ever felt a sudden wave of cringe toward someone you were into—all because they wore questionable shoes or chewed a bit too loudly? Congratulations, you've caught "the ick." That instant flip from attraction to total repulsion is everywhere on TikTok and Instagram, with singles and couples bonding over the specific, often ridiculous triggers that turned them off. But beyond the viral memes and funny rants, why does our br
item.content:encoded:
The ick: The psychology of why a romantic partner can suddenly repulse you
Ever felt a sudden wave of cringe toward someone you were into—all because they wore questionable shoes or chewed a bit too loudly? Congratulations, you've caught "the ick."
That instant flip from attraction to total repulsion is everywhere on TikTok and Instagram, with singles and couples bonding over the specific, often ridiculous triggers that turned them off. But beyond the viral memes and funny rants, why does our brain sometimes hit the brakes so fast on an attraction?
There are a number of potential explanations. Some psychologists have argued that the ick might be linked to the phenomenon of sexual disgust. Sexual disgust is hypothesized to be an emotion shaped by evolutionary selection pressure—the idea being that women are hardwired to choose males they can successfully mate with to ensure the survival of their babies.
From this perspective, while perhaps overzealous, the ick serves to ensure appropriate mating. This theory comes with its limitations, however, as not all women are dating or in relationships to reproduce. Additionally, this doesn't necessarily explain why men also get the ick and overlooks individual differences in the purposes relationships serve. It also doesn't make sense for people in same-sex relationships.
There have also been theories about the ick being linked to relationship anxiety. In relationship psychology, those with avoidant attachment styles avoid emotional closeness. So, when people with avoidant traits are dating or in a relationship, this may cause some anxiety for them.
Arguably, the ick may act as a defense mechanism to allow them to create distance from others and maintain their independence, which is their "safe space." This suggests that avoidant people use the ick as a way of keeping themselves safe and maintaining a distance from others.
We should also consider associations between past and current behaviors in potential partners. Some people may feel triggered by particular behaviors or mannerisms that remind them of past partners, meaning that they associate that behavior with feeling icked out.
Classical conditioning is pertinent here. If we are conditioned to associate particular stimuli in the environment with disgust (such as witnessing someone consistently picking their nose and being told it is a disgusting habit), we are likely to become repulsed if we see the behavior in others later and ultimately get the ick toward the person displaying that behavior.
An alternative explanation for the ick could be linked to certain phobias. For example, if someone has misophonia—sensitivity leading to decreased tolerance of certain sounds—this may mean things like loud chewing cause irritation.
Ultimately, the answer to why people get the ick isn't straightforward. All these proposed theories have their merits and limitations. But it appears to come down to individual differences.
This article is republished from The Conversation under a Creative Commons license. Read the original article.

item.title: [Martha Stewart] The Top 20 Wedding Trends of 2027, From Antique Lace to Hush-Hush Honeymoons
item.dc:creator: Michele Laufik
item.description: From floral arrangements featuring poppies and hydrangeas to unconventional venue choices, 2027 weddings will be filled with personal touches and unexpected moments. That’s according to the latest findings from The Knot. The wedding planning site just released its 2027 Wedding Trends Report, a look at what’s growing in popularity among couples right now. To compile the list, the editors at The Knot reviewed dozens of trending wedding concepts that they believed could result in widespread adoptio
item.content:encoded:
From floral arrangements featuring poppies and hydrangeas to unconventional venue choices, 2027 weddings will be filled with personal touches and unexpected moments. That’s according to the latest findings from The Knot.
The wedding planning site just released its 2027 Wedding Trends Report, a look at what’s growing in popularity among couples right now.
To compile the list, the editors at The Knot reviewed dozens of trending wedding concepts that they believed could result in widespread adoption across weddings in 2027. Those predictions were then validated by a pre-selected group of wedding vendors from The Knot Vendor Marketplace. Additionally, to provide comprehensive insights, The Knot Worldwide analyzed on-site behavioral data through June 2026, in addition to existing data on its U.S. audience of pre-engaged and engaged couples.
Here are the top 20 wedding trends that are expected to dominate 2027.
Sophisticated Colors
Primary color palettes for 2027 nuptials are predicted to incorporate shades like regal merlot, plums, powdery blues, and moss greens. Secondary colors to supplement these bold hues include blush pinks and champagnes. The Knot reports a 127 percent increase year-over-year in this trend.
Antique Lace
According to The Knot editors, lace is no longer limited to bridal gowns and veils, noting a 280 percent year-over-year increase in the look. The vintage-style fabric is now dressing up wedding stationery, as well as tablescapes and décor. “Lace nods to vintage beauty and antique design, yet it feels modern at the same time,” planner Danielle Elder of Classic Events says in the report.
The Beach Club
Engaged couples are exploring ways to bring the Amalfi Coast to their weddings back home, according to the report. The Knot points to design ideas like spritz bars for cocktail hour, cabana stripes across patio furniture, lemon-embellished tablescapes and stationery, and textiles steeped in sun-dappled marigolds and Mediterranean blues.
“Couples planning multi-day experiences want to incorporate a fun poolside or oceanfront experience for their guests,” says designer and planner Jason Rhee of Rheefined Company. “I also think with Italy being a trendy destination, it’s becoming an inspiration piece for many couples.” The trend has seen a whopping 315 percent increase in interest.
Swans & Balletcore
More couples are taking pointers from Tchaikovsky’s Swan Lake and embellishing their weddings with swan motifs and other balletcore elements such as ribbons, loose bows, textured draping, and crystal, The Knot editors found.
Related Stories
Monofloral Installations
More submissions are coming into The Knot‘s Real Wedding section that include hydrangea, moss, or wisteria installations. Depending on the flower type, single floral designs can be more impactful than mixed arrangements, with the report revealing that the concept is trending up. “The look is tailored, organic, and neat, but messy and almost like a still-life painting,” Elder says. “Antique hydrangea is having a huge comeback.”
Whimsical Florals
Whimsical flowers, in particular the poppy, are gaining popularity, as are other blooms that present a similar aesthetic. It’s all about playful petals.
The Silver (Ag)e
Silver (or Ag, as its abbreviation on the Periodic Table of elements) is making a fresh comeback. The sterling transition metal is influencing wedding accessories, stationery, dinnerware, and flatware, according to the report. “The silver accents we’ve seen to date feel like a fun meshing of vintage charm and modern elegance,” says Micaela Erickson, director of marketing at Vesper, citing examples like “vintage silver trays holding lighters, cigarettes, and other vices for guests to indulge in, eclectic mirrors with the couple’s monogram, and almost futuristic silver floral arrangements.”
The Arts as Inspiration
The arts, including photography, painting, music, sculpture, and more, are influencing the creative direction of weddings even more lately, including venue choices. “I’m seeing the arts pop up in engagement shoots. Couples are also leaning toward art museums and libraries, and including stained glass pieces, particularly, in their welcome signage,” says Lexsey Lanzotti of Zotti & Co.
Unconventional Venues
Within the last year, The Knot editors and their consulting vendors have seen weddings hosted at beach clubs, members clubs, townhomes, spas, and even sports arenas. “I think people are really starting to venture out and do things their own way,” Lanzotti says.
The Wedding Brand
A wedding’s iconography is now easily identifiable from the moment a guest receives a save-the-date and opens up the couple’s wedding website. Custom crests, bespoke illustrations, and personalized pieces as part of a branding puzzle are in demand. “We like to say it’s akin to a leitmotif in an opera or a piece of music. It’s a consistent thread that helps tell the story through melodies rather than words,” Elder says.
Prop Surrealism
The Knot notes that more couples are now requesting unexpected texture for their backdrops, design layouts, and more. “This is a fun opportunity for couples to showcase their taste, creativity, and interests,” Erickson says. “It’ll result in exciting, playful photo moments for couples and guests, and subvert more traditional wedding expectations.”
Interior Design Weddings
Lately, couples want their guests to feel “at home,” according to The Knot, so they’re creating a wedding environment that reflects their residential preferences. Table lamps, menu tassels, and even coffee table guest books offer the look of a luxurious interior space.
The Pop-Up … Plus
Moving beyond merch, wedding favors are now full-blown pop-up experiences—something that guests can enjoy in the moment and take home to savor. Think a fragrance station, a bouquet bar, or espresso martini service.
Playing With Food and Interactive F&B
Interactive food and beverage options are giving couples and wedding guests permission to play with their food. “We’re planning a secret pickle bar in the vault of the wedding venue,” says Carly Katz-Hackman, partner at Pinch Food Design, about an upcoming wedding planned by Pinch. “Think pickleback shots, pickled onion martinis, plus all the crunchy goodness you can imagine. Who needs bar nuts when you can have pickles?”
Cultural Menus
According to The Knot research, 60 percent of couples find it important to incorporate ethnicity, religion, and/or culture into their weddings. This is translating into menus that are deeply personal and meaningful. “We’ve definitely seen a ton of requests to infuse the couple’s culture into their wedding menu to show not only where they come from as individuals, but how they plan to move forward as a couple,” Katz says. “Whether it’s an Indian station for him, plus a Maryland station for her, and a New York station for them; or a full Chinese banquet dinner, plus challah made by the mother of the bride…We’re seeing worlds collide in the best way.”
Editorial-Cinematic Photos
Couples want to feel like the main character on their big day, and they’re using photography to give them the cinematic treatment, The Knot reports. “The photo requests that I’m seeing most right now are for images to feel emotional,” Lanzotti says. “Instead of standard, posed photos, couples want it to feel dreamy, romantic, artsy… People are really into creative composition lately.”
Experiential Stationery
In 2027, expect couples to get even more creative about their paper products—from save-the-dates to escort cards. According to the report, inspiration ranges from custom illustrations and handwritten lettering to pop-up designs on menus and wedding ceremony program fans. “There’s a definite shift towards hyper curation; for both documentation and immortalization,” Erickson says. “The desire to make aesthetics bold, unique, and highly tailored has never been stronger.”
Analog Registries
What’s old is new again, especially when it comes to wedding registries. Couples are seeking old-school cocktail glasses, camcorders, hip retro appliances, and vintage-style record players with modern capabilities as gifts.
Hush-Hush Honeymoons
Tougher-to-access resorts and destinations are gaining interest among couples, The Knot reports. Private villa resorts and ultra-luxury hotels offer a scenic escape from crowds, especially in romantic hotspots like Santorini, the Amalfi Coast, and Ibiza. Alternatively, lesser-known islands across the Mediterranean that require an extra ferry ride are worth the journey to some. Ships are another out-of-the-way choice.
Extending the Wedding
With the revival of courthouse ceremonies and the growth in welcome parties, couples are maximizing every wedding moment. “A wedding weekend is not just a celebration of two people anymore, where the focus is solely inward,” Elder says. “Couples now want that energy, love, and goodness pointed outward to experience and share with their guests.”

item.title: [The Times of India] Zodiac Love Horoscope, 6 October 2026: Mercury Meets Venus as a Long-Awaited Confession or Important Love Conversation Could Finally Happen
item.dc:creator: Neeraj Dhankher
item.description: Love may become easier to express on October 6, 2026, as Mercury meets Venus. Someone could admit attraction, talk about future plans, or discuss a relationship problem more openly. Singles may receive an interesting message, while couples may find it easier to say what is on their minds. How to Navigate Today’s Energy Choose kind words, but speak honestly. Mercury meets Venus, making this a useful time to show affection, apologise, send romantic messages and discuss what comes next. Two people
item.content:encoded:
Love may become easier to express on October 6, 2026, as Mercury meets Venus. Someone could admit attraction, talk about future plans, or discuss a relationship problem more openly. Singles may receive an interesting message, while couples may find it easier to say what is on their minds.
How to Navigate Today’s Energy
Choose kind words, but speak honestly. Mercury meets Venus, making this a useful time to show affection, apologise, send romantic messages and discuss what comes next. Two people can finally address something they have both been avoiding. Singles can learn more about someone through a meaningful conversation instead of relying only on flirtation. Listen carefully too; someone’s words may reveal feelings they have struggled to express.
Zodiac Signs That Need Care Today
Virgo: You might read too much into a romantic conversation and miss the point. Wait until they’re done before you start looking for hidden messages. Not every sentence that is not perfect is a problem.
Aries: You may get annoyed if someone is taking too long to explain how they feel. Don’t interrupt and demand an immediate answer.
If they feel safe enough to talk, they might be more truthful.
Scorpio: A confession may make you feel guilty or raise doubts about trust. Don’t turn the conversation into an investigation. Listen to what is being offered now.
Aquarius: You may find someone speaking to you more emotionally than you expected. Don’t shy away from getting personal in your conversation. A thoughtful answer might make the connection more obvious.
Zodiac Signs That May Enjoy Good Luck
Gemini: Mercury makes it easy for you to talk to people. A surprise message, call or conversation can be a sign that you are both interested. It can also help couples clear up any confusion by having a direct but friendly discussion.
Libra: Venus helps you to be charming and to keep your emotions under control. You may find the right words to express what you have struggled to say. Singles could get clearer signals from a crush.
Taurus: Open up more and love can feel more secure. Someone’s reassuring words may finally match the consistency you have been hoping for.
Cancer: Opening up emotionally could deepen your intimacy. Maybe a partner will talk about something personal, or maybe a single person will be interested in someone who talks to them with warmth and real interest.
Balanced Day for These Zodiac Signs
Leo: When two people talk about love, make sure they have time to talk.
Sagittarius: Honesty helps, but don’t answer questions about commitment just to keep things exciting.
Capricorn: With practical matters dominating every discussion, it’s harder to talk about deep feelings.
Pisces: A sweet message may touch you deeply, but watch to see whether your future actions back up what you said.
Lucky Action of the Day
Say the one thing you have been putting off. Simple, honest words can open a door to the heart that fear has kept closed.

item.content:encoded:
Love Horoscope Today, 7 October 2026: Doubts, Distance or a New Connection? What the Stars Say About Your Love Life
Synopsis
Love Horoscope for 7 October 2026 brings a more complicated emotional mood, where assumptions can easily become louder than facts. The Leo Moon with Ketu may make some people question a partner's behaviour, while retrograde Venus and Mercury in Libra bring relationship conversations back into focus. For some, a message from someone distant or a past connection may reopen a thought. For others, the real test will be knowing when to ask, listen and not jump to conclusions.
Aries Love Horoscope Today
Single: You may find yourself thinking more seriously about whether a new attraction is actually worth pursuing. Someone could catch your attention, but your first instinct may be to analyse every little detail. Let the connection develop naturally instead of deciding too soon what it means.
In a relationship: A small doubt may appear around your partner's behaviour. The important thing is not to turn that doubt into an interrogation. Ask what you genuinely want to know and listen to the answer. Children or family matters may also become part of the conversation.
Married: Work and household responsibilities can leave little room for emotional conversations. If something has been bothering you, bring it up calmly rather than letting it change your behaviour. Spending some unhurried time with family can help you feel grounded again.
Also Read: Aries Horoscope 2026| Aries October Horoscope | Aries Weekly Horoscope
Taurus Love Horoscope Today
Single: Your emotional state may be influenced by what is happening at home. You could feel less open to romance if family worries are occupying your mind. A new connection can wait. Protecting your peace is more important today.
In a relationship: You may become unusually alert to changes in your partner's behaviour. That does not automatically mean something is wrong. A small disagreement can become much bigger if both of you start reacting instead of talking.
Married: Domestic tension could affect the relationship more than the original issue deserves. If you are worried about a family member or something at home, tell your spouse what you need instead of expecting them to understand your silence.
Also Read: Taurus Horoscope 2026| Taurus October Horoscope | Taurus Weekly Horoscope
Gemini Love Horoscope Today
Single: You may be drawn towards someone because the conversation feels unusually honest. But do not confuse emotional intensity with instant compatibility. Give yourself time to understand the person beyond the first few conversations.
In a relationship: This is a good day to say what you have been keeping private. If a doubt has been sitting in your mind, expressing it gently can bring relief. Your tone matters because you may sound harsher than you intend.
Also Read: Gemini Horoscope 2026| Gemini October Horoscope | Gemini Weekly Horoscope
Cancer Love Horoscope Today
Single: Your intuition may feel unusually sharp. You could sense that someone is interested in you before they say anything directly. Still, intuition is a starting point, not proof. Watch how the person actually behaves.
In a relationship: You may feel that something is slightly off, even if you cannot explain why. Avoid creating a story around that feeling. A calm conversation with your partner will tell you more than repeatedly analysing their behaviour.
Married: Financial or household concerns may make you more emotionally reactive than usual. If something has been bothering you, share it with your spouse. Keeping suspicion to yourself can create a distance that the original issue never required.
Also Read: Cancer Horoscope 2026| Cancer October Horoscope | Cancer Weekly Horoscope
Leo Love Horoscope Today
Single: The Moon and Ketu in your sign can make you unusually selective about who gets access to your attention. You may also feel restless without knowing exactly what you want. A conversation with a friend could help you understand your own feelings better.
In a relationship: You may have something to say but hesitate because you do not want another argument. Say it anyway, but without turning the conversation into blame. A distant person may also contact you and shift your emotional focus.
Married: Your attention could scatter between your relationship, family and several unrelated concerns. Do not let irritation come out as silence or sharp replies. Your spouse may simply need to know what is going on in your mind.
Also Read: Leo Horoscope 2026| Leo October Horoscope | Leo Weekly Horoscope
Virgo Love Horoscope Today
Single: Distance could become part of your love story today. Someone living in another city or country may become more important through calls or messages. A long conversation can create closeness even when meeting is not possible.
In a relationship: If you and your partner have been physically apart, the distance may feel more noticeable today. Talking openly about plans, travel or when you will meet next can make the relationship feel more secure.
Married: A call from someone close or news about a family visit could change your routine. If you have been carrying questions about the relationship alone, share them. You do not have to solve every emotional issue by yourself.
Also Read: Virgo Horoscope 2026| Virgo October Horoscope | Virgo Weekly Horoscope
Libra Love Horoscope Today
Single: This is one of the more interesting signs for love today. Mercury and retrograde Venus meet in your sign, bringing attraction and conversation into the same space. Someone you already know may suddenly look different to you, or an old interaction may make you rethink what you want.
In a relationship: Your partner's behaviour could leave you with questions, particularly if something reminds you of an older disagreement. Do not investigate through assumptions or outside opinions. Ask directly. The answer may be much simpler than the story your mind creates.
Married: A family or religious gathering may keep you occupied, while something someone says continues to stay in your head. Talk to your spouse before discussing private matters with friends. Today, protecting the relationship's privacy may matter more than getting outside validation.
Also Read: Libra Horoscope 2026| Libra October Horoscope | Libra Weekly Horoscope
Scorpio Love Horoscope Today
Single: Someone may show interest, but you could wonder whether their intentions are genuine. Take your time. You do not need to reject a connection simply because you are cautious, but you also do not need to trust too quickly.
In a relationship: Work stress could follow you home and affect how you speak to your partner. There is also a possibility of confusion caused by something a third person says. Verify before reacting.
Married: Keep private relationship matters private. If someone outside the marriage offers an opinion, remember that they may not know the full story. A calm conversation between you and your spouse will be more useful than outside commentary.
Also Read: Scorpio Horoscope 2026| Scorpio October Horoscope | Scorpio Weekly Horoscope
Sagittarius Love Horoscope Today
Single: An unexpected message could come from someone you have not spoken to in a while. You may feel curious about where the conversation could go, especially if distance was the reason you lost touch.
In a relationship: Be careful with your wording. Something you mean casually could be interpreted differently by your partner. Travel or work commitments may also leave them feeling that you have less time for the relationship than usual.
Married: A distant relative or old contact may bring news into the family. At the same time, your own schedule could become hectic. Make sure your spouse does not feel pushed to the side while you handle everything else.
Also Read: Sagittarius Horoscope 2026| Sagittarius October Horoscope |Sagittarius Weekly Horoscope
Capricorn Love Horoscope Today
Single: You may question whether someone else's attention is genuine. Rather than comparing what they say with what someone else tells you, watch their actions over time. Your judgement will be clearer when you are not under pressure to decide immediately.
In a relationship: A sudden change in the relationship may make you uneasy. Do not let another person's comment create suspicion between you and your partner. If something feels wrong, discuss it directly.
Married: Family pressure could make you emotionally withdrawn. Your spouse may sense the distance without knowing its reason. Spending some quiet time together in the evening can help you reconnect without forcing a heavy conversation.
Also Read: Capricorn Horoscope 2026| Capricorn October Horoscope | Capricorn Weekly Horoscope
Aquarius Love Horoscope Today
Single: You may meet someone through your social circle, but the bigger story could be figuring out whether you actually trust the connection. Avoid sharing too much too soon, particularly with people you barely know.
In a relationship: A third person's opinion could create unnecessary confusion between you and your partner. Keep relationship matters between the two of you. What feels like a small comment today can become a bigger misunderstanding if repeated.
Married: You may feel emotionally distant even while being physically close to your spouse. Instead of reacting to something a family member says, give your partner the benefit of a direct conversation. Privacy and patience will protect the relationship today.
Also Read: Aquarius Horoscope 2026| Aquarius October Horoscope | Aquarius Weekly Horoscope
Pisces Love Horoscope Today
Single: You may feel pulled between what you want and what seems practical. Do not force yourself into a romantic decision simply because you are tired of uncertainty. Someone close may help you see the situation more clearly.
In a relationship: Your needs and your partner's needs may not line up perfectly today. That does not mean the relationship is failing. Give each other some breathing room before trying to solve everything at once.
Married: You may become fixed on getting things done your way, while your spouse needs something different. The wiser move is to pause rather than push the conversation further. A heart-to-heart with someone you trust can also help you release the pressure.
Also Read: Pisces Horoscope 2026| Pisces October Horoscope | Pisces Weekly Horoscope
Conclusion
The love horoscope for 7 October 2026 is a reminder to separate intuition from assumption. A changed tone or outside opinion may raise questions, but direct conversation can reveal what is actually happening. Give love room for honesty, privacy and perspective.
Today's forecast for other signs: Aries - Gemini, October 7, 2026 | Cancer - Virgo, October 7, 2026 | Libra - Sagittarius, October 7, 2026 | Capricorn - Pisces, October 7, 2026
Written by: Tanya Singh of Astropatri.com

Simon Leviev, the name he goes by, became internationally notorious after a 2022 Netflix documentary detailed how women said they had been deceived and scammed through dating apps. item.content:encoded:
The man made infamous as the "Tinder Swindler" wants to launch a dating app designed to keep users safe.
Simon Leviev, the name he goes by, became internationally notorious after a 2022 Netflix documentary detailed how women said they had been deceived and scammed through dating apps.
Now, according to 702/CapeTalk's Barbara Friedman, Leviev wants to launch his own dating app, called Safe Love.
And, unsurprisingly, the idea has caused quite a stir online.
Related articles:
‘You can’t make this up’
Friedman described the proposal as one of the more offbeat stories making the rounds, pointing out the apparent irony of Leviev wanting to create a dating app focused on safety.
"The man who allegedly scammed women out of millions of dollars on dating apps says he's reformed," she said.
Leviev reportedly says Safe Love will include several safety features, including ID checks, facial verification and an SOS feature intended to protect users from romance scammers and unsafe situations.
"He wants to launch a safe dating app," Friedman said. "And, of course, the internet is exploding over this."
She also said an organisation representing the online dating industry is calling for the proposed app to be stopped, with Apple and Google being urged to prevent it from appearing in their app stores.
‘Who better to educate women from getting scammed?’
The proposal prompted plenty of scepticism from the presenters.
"You can't make this up," Friedman said.
CapeTalk’s Clarence Ford joked: "Who are the best cybersecurity experts? Hackers."
"Well, there you go. Maybe he's on to something," came the response.
"He knows the tricks of the trade," added Ford.
Friedman said the reaction online had included comments such as "are we being punked?", while others questioned whether the app should be supported at all.
"That’s a no from me," she said.
She also pointed to Leviev's history with the law, saying he had been sentenced to several years in prison in three different countries.
Dating apps are now part of everyday life
The conversation also turned to how dramatically dating has changed since the emergence of dating apps.
One presenter said he had never used a dating app, while Friedman recalled using one in the late 2000s.
She said dating apps had become part of everyday life for younger people.
"It’s a way to meet people that you would never meet," she said.
But when it comes to a dating app launched by the man known as the Tinder Swindler, the presenters appeared considerably less enthusiastic.
As one of them put it, the question of whether to download it was unequivocal:
"She will absolutely unequivocally not download the app."

item.content:encoded:
Your Love Horoscope Is Here For Tuesday, October 6: A Beautiful Day For Romance
Your zodiac sign's daily love horoscope is here for October 6, 2026. The Moon and Jupiter unite in Leo on Tuesday, helping you follow your heart and declare your feelings to someone special. Just be sure it’s genuine.
Leo is a fire sign that rules the heart, so you're finally able to do what you’ve always desired. However, Leo can also get distracted by looks and drama. Enjoy the optimism and passion this day brings, but slow down enough to make sure any feelings you have are genuine.
Love horoscopes for each zodiac sign on Tuesday, October 6, 2026:
Aries
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Love can be better than you imagine, Aries. October 6 is all about romance and following your heart. It's time to create space in your life for what you’ve always desired. But you must make sure you’re not being too cynical or pragmatic, or you may miss out on the magic that Tuesday is meant to bring.
Let yourself get carried away by your emotions and focus on bringing more romance into your life. If you’re already with that special person, let them know just how much you care.
Taurus
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Love doesn’t need to look a particular way to be real, Taurus. On Tuesday, focus on how something feels rather than how it looks.
When it comes to relationships and even the choices you’ve made for your life overall, you’ve always focused on how it would look from the outside. But other people's approval doesn’t really matter. October 6 is a day to choose the person you want, no matter what others think.
Gemini
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
You aren’t meant to hold it in, Gemini. Let your heart speak. Tuesday's energy inspires you to share or take action so there is no question as to what you are feeling or what you want for the future.
You may unintentionally go overboard on October 6, because Jupiter makes sure any declaration goes beyond the norm. Be expressive with your emotions and don’t hesitate to make an offer no one would be able to refuse.
Cancer
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
This is what it feels like to be worthy, Cancer. October 6 is about you finally understanding what it feels like to live abundantly. This may bring an exciting invite or a romantic interest. But it’s really about you understanding the difference between lack and abundance.
It can be challenging to finally receive what you’ve always deserved after not getting it for so long. Yet, in doing so, you set a new standard in your relationships and your life.
Leo
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Make sure you mean it, Leo. You are one of the most dramatic and, at times, flamboyant zodiac signs. You attract attention and glances wherever you go, and honestly, you prefer it that way.
Yet, on Tuesday, you must make sure you genuinely mean any actions you take. You may get carried away with your own emotions and find yourself overpromising a particular dream. It’s OK to go after what you want; just keep two feet on the ground while you do.
Virgo
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
The energy of the Moon and Jupiter works in mysterious ways on Tuesday, Virgo. It's enhancing your intuition, so pay attention.
If you’ve been feeling optimistic and ready to take a leap of faith, this is what you need to do. However, if you’ve been afraid of what the future holds or uncertain about your choices, this will be enhanced as well. Sit with what comes up, knowing it’s all part of the process.
Libra
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Don’t say yes just yet, Libra. Someone is coming into your life unexpectedly, and they seem to be everything you’ve ever wanted. They may arrive on Tuesday, or they could have shown up in the last few months.
While this person is part of you stepping out of your comfort zone and living your best life, be careful about saying yes just yet. Take some time and get to know this person before upending your life.
Scorpio
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Let this be the start of a new chapter, Scorpio. Embrace the confidence and self-assurance you're feeling on Tuesday.
While this may benefit your career in the short term, it also has massive implications for your romantic life. When you finally have confidence in yourself, the choices you make change for the better. All you need to do is let them.
Sagittarius
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
A new beginning must come from your heart, Sagittarius. There is an inspiring energy in the air on Tuesday, but you must realize what its true purpose is.
While Leo is bringing you luck and new beginnings, it’s crucial that you practice discretion when it comes to the choices you make. It’s not about doing any one thing, but choosing what and who you actually feel connected to.
Capricorn
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Love should never be a bartering tool, Capricorn. October 6 brings a surge of emotion and the feeling that you can do anything. But you must make sure you're using this feeling wisely.
This energy can make you use your emotions, or those of another person, to further your own interests. While it may not be intentional or overtly cold, it doesn’t mean it will turn out the way you think it will. Be genuine and remember that love is best when it’s freely given.
Aquarius
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
Lean into your flirt, Aquarius. October 6 brings a burst of romance and new possibilities. While this energy enhances your ability to flirt and attract the right kind of attention, there's more to it.
The Moon and Jupiter in Leo help you focus on how you want to feel in your life instead of specific things or milestones. So, be spontaneous and embrace new possibilities for love. But also make sure you’re investing your energy into a life that feels like yours.
Pisces
Photos: NASA & sparklestroke | Design: YourTango
This is only the start of what’s to come, Pisces. The energy on Tuesday puts a spotlight on you and your life. This allows you to finally be seen for what you bring to the table and the kind of person you truly are. But it also brings in exciting possibilities for change.
Be sure you’re finding balance between tossing caution to the wind and grounding yourself in what is real. Know that this is only the beginning of what you will be attracting in the year to come.
Kate Rose is a writer, spiritual astrologist, relationship and life intuitive counselor, and bespoke retreat curator.

item.title: [TechCrunch] Hot Girl Hotline is like 'Dear Abby' for the AI era | TechCrunch
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Women throughout history have always sought out relationship advice, whether from newspaper columnists like “Dear Abby,” letters to Cosmo, or just chatting with girlfriends. In the social media era, you can instead post anonymously on Reddit relationship forums or look to social media creators who discuss the topic. Now, two sisters are launching a startup for young women, Hot Girl Hotline, which focuses on bringing AI into these conversations. I know what you may be thinking: With all the advan
item.content:encoded:
Women throughout history have always sought out relationship advice, whether from newspaper columnists like “Dear Abby,” letters to Cosmo, or just chatting with girlfriends. In the social media era, you can instead post anonymously on Reddit relationship forums or look to social media creators who discuss the topic.
Now, two sisters are launching a startup for young women, Hot Girl Hotline, which focuses on bringing AI into these conversations.
I know what you may be thinking: With all the advances in AI technology, founders are building something for women to talk about their dating woes? Well … yes!
The reality is that people have already been turning to large language models (LLMs) via apps like ChatGPT for this type of advice, and the team believes this type of activity should be handled more carefully.
Unfortunately, as we’ve seen, chatting with a general-purpose chatbot about personal topics can sometimes lead to disastrous effects — especially for those who were already mentally fragile. ChatGPT, for example, has faced a wave of lawsuits over its alleged manipulative conversation tactics that plaintiffs say contributed to negative mental health effects, including, in some cases, suicide.
The idea behind Hot Girl Hotline is to reach young women who are looking to have these sorts of private conversations while navigating dating life and relationships, but in a safer way.
“We’re not trying to be an AI companion,” explained Baila Mudgil, formerly a social media consultant, who co-founded the startup with her sister Sumrin (“Sumi”), who studied computer science at Stanford. “A companion is really going after solving loneliness, escapism, boredom — and you can rely on a lot of emotional dependency from that AI companion.”
Baila says the startup’s approach is to focus on offering quality advice grounded in behavioral science, but in a way that makes it feel like you’re chatting with a trusted friend or big sister. The conversation is often Socratic, with the AI asking you questions to help you arrive at the answer yourself.
“This is not to replace speaking to a human. This is not clinical advice, and we have a lot of safeguards in place … we take safety really seriously,” Baila said. If conversations raise flags, for instance, the user is referred to resources such as the crisis hotline 988.
“We believe the key to quality advice is not just knowing what to do next; it’s understanding why you’re doing it. So that’s a big piece of it,” added Sumi.
Notably, the AI also knows when to end the conversation; it doesn’t keep asking follow-up questions to drag you further down a rabbit hole. Instead, it pushes users to go take action out in the real world rather than ruminate on the problem.
The sisters believe there’s room for an app like this because not everyone wants to post on the web for advice, and there are times when you don’t want to bring up a personal, dating, or relationship-focused issue with a friend.
Friends can bring their own biases into the conversation, or the user may not want to put their partner on blast for something they did before they determine whether they’re going to work through it or end the relationship.
“It doesn’t mean you’re replacing your friend — you’re just trying to get another perspective,” says Baila of the hotline.
The app also personalizes its advice for each user to reflect their values, goals, identity, and tastes.
Under the hood, the startup relies on a mix of AI models and encrypts users’ data in transit and at rest. It doesn’t sell or train on the data, either. When it uses a third-party AI model, it follows a zero-data-retention policy there as well.
Hot Girl Hotline plans to monetize through a $9.99 per month subscription, which hundreds of its most active users are already paying for. Later, it may incorporate ads, too.
Relationship advice is just the beginning of how the company wants to cater to young women. It also plans to expand into other areas, like beauty and lifestyle.
New York-based Hot Girl Hotline is currently bootstrapped and will be participating in the Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, taking place October 13-15 in San Francisco. It’s available on iOS and the web.

item.title: [The Times of India] Zodiac Love Horoscope, 5 October 2026: Leo Moon Raises Passion and Attraction, but Pride Could Make Someone Harder to Read
item.dc:creator: Neeraj Dhankher
item.description: You will feel more attractive and more confident in your relationship and want to be noticed. The Moon in Leo can make love stronger and more open, but pride can make simple feelings harder to express. Someone may care a lot but be scared to show their vulnerability. item.content:encoded:
You will feel more attractive and more confident in your relationship and want to be noticed. The Moon in Leo can make love stronger and more open, but pride can make simple feelings harder to express. Someone may care a lot but be scared to show their vulnerability. Singles may feel chemistry immediately, and couples may want more attention.
How to Navigate Today’s Energy
Show your love, but don’t try to outdo each other over who cares more. The Moon in Leo brings out the romantic and playful side of people and increases the desire for attention. People can also become sensitive if they feel ignored or undervalued. Don’t use silence to get someone’s attention. Singles can enjoy attraction, but they should not assume dramatic chemistry guarantees emotional reliability. Real feelings are easier to discuss when sincere appreciation softens pride.
Zodiac Signs That Need Care Today
Aquarius: You may be called on to express more warmth than you exhibit. Don’t retreat just because the other person wants to feel better. A little show of affection can keep people from misreading each other.
Taurus: You are proud, and you might not be able to say that something hurt you.
If you say nothing, the other person might assume everything is fine. When you speak, don't make the problem bigger than it needs to be.
Scorpio:
You may find yourself very attracted to someone who seems hard to read. Don’t test their interest by being jealous or distant. If you are honest, you will get better information.
Capricorn: You might want to be useful, while your partner may want more affection. Love doesn’t always need an escape route. The other person just wants to feel important and noticed sometimes.
Zodiac Signs That May Enjoy Good Luck
Leo: Today, it is hard not to notice how charming you are and how much emotion you are pouring out. Nature may take notice of single people, but a romantic gesture or a spur-of-the-moment trip can reunite a couple.
Aries: You may find it easier to express your passion now. Confidence can help a new connection move quickly, while more fun and physical closeness can help established relationships.
Libra: Others' presence may spark romantic possibilities. If you're naturally good with people, you can reel them in without trying so hard, especially if you let the conversation get a little more personal.
Sagittarius: Love is more fun, lighter. Chemistry that lasts may be sparked by a date, an outing, or an unexpected invitation. Couples may like the chance to get away from their normal routines together.
Balanced Day for These Zodiac Signs
Gemini: It’s easy to flirt, but someone might want more concrete proof that you’re interested.
Cancer: Emotional support given without being asked for can strengthen affection.
Virgo: Your relationship may improve when you avoid judging every action the other person takes.
Pisces:
Your feelings may grow slowly, but you have to be sure of yourself to say what you really think.
Lucky Action of the Day
Give someone a real compliment and ask for absolutely nothing in return. Genuine appreciation can help to break down emotional walls and make attraction easier to understand.

item.title: [Yahoo] 'Dry Begging' Is A Form Of Emotional Manipulation That Sounds All Too Familiar
item.dc:creator: Jillian Wilson
item.description: Have you ever frustratingly mumbled to your partner that it "must be nice to have a partner who walks the dog" in hopes of them walking the dog more often? Or have you ever sighed that you'll "just do the errands alone" even though you don't want to? Turns out, you may be dry begging, a tool that people use in relationships of all sorts to get their needs met. "Dry begging is when someone indirectly asks for something. There's a need there, but they're not stating it clearly," said Aerial Cetnar
item.content:encoded:
Have you ever frustratingly mumbled to your partner that it "must be nice to have a partner who walks the dog" in hopes of them walking the dog more often? Or have you ever sighed that you'll "just do the errands alone" even though you don't want to? Turns out, you may be dry begging, a tool that people use in relationships of all sorts to get their needs met.
"Dry begging is when someone indirectly asks for something. There's a need there, but they're not stating it clearly," said Aerial Cetnar, a therapist and owner of Boulder Therapy and Wellness in Colorado.
Instead of making a straightforward request or voicing a direct want, someone who is dry begging hints at a need or makes a vague complaint, Cetnar added.
So, instead of stating, "I wish we spent more time together," someone who is dry begging may say, "Oh, I guess I'll just stay home with the cat" — they're hinting at their displeasure instead of addressing it.
"I'll say it can come from a place of insecurity, fear or manipulation," said Tori-Lyn Mills, a licensed clinical professional counselor with Thriveworks in Columbia, MD. But it can also be something that folks grew up with and learned as a way to get their needs met, Mills added.
It's also not an official psychological term that you'll find in mental health literature, said Cetnar — "regardless, it's very much a thing."
Relationship: 9 Signs You're Dealing With 'Weaponized Empathy'
While it can feel easier than directly asking for what you want, dry begging really isn't meant for the long haul. Here's why.
Dry begging weaponizes emotion.
According to Mills, dry begging can weaponize emotion and empathy while also shifting responsibility in a situation. It can "even weaponize a person's role as a partner, specifically in romantic relationships," she said.
For example, in a romantic relationship, if one partner wants to have *** and the other doesn't, instead of flat-out saying how they feel, someone who is dry begging may say something like "well, most people would be happy that their partner wants to have *** with them all the time [and] is attracted to them all the time," Mills said.
This can put the other partner in a position where they feel guilty about not wanting to have *** in the moment. It can even put responsibility on them and make them think, "Oh, I should be happy about this," Mills noted.
Relationship: Sometimes 'Let Me Know If You Need Anything' Is The Worst Thing You Can Say — Here's Why
"It's kind of like — I should be giving into this. That's how dry begging can work," she said.
If this sounds manipulative, it's because it often is.
If it becomes a pattern, that's a red flag for manipulation, Cetnar said. More, if the partner ends up doing things they don't want to do without ever being clearly asked, it's another red flag, she said.
"It's not always manipulative — it certainly can be — but I like to give people the benefit of the doubt. First, look at what's the intention and is it a pattern," Cetnar said. Once again, if it's a pattern, that is not OK.
If it's just an occasional happening, it probably isn't a big deal, she said.
In some cases (but not all), it can be a narcissistic tendency.
Dry begging is often linked to narcissism, and while both experts said it certainly can be a tool narcissists use to get their needs met, not everyone who occasionally dry begs is a narcissist.
"With narcissism, there is a high level of entitlement. You may get a hint or a prompt, but you could get a lot more covert demands," said Mills.
In the case of a narcissist and dry begging, they may explicitly try to elicit guilt in their partner when they dry beg or weaponize empathy to get their partner to do what they want, Mills explained.
"Narcissists are typically seen as manipulative. And so there can be an overlap," Cetnar added. Narcissists are often needy, too, she said, and dry begging is definitively needy behavior.
"I'm just going to continue to passively say something or ask for something in the hopes that people will just give me what I want," Cetnar added.
Like this article? Keep independent journalism alive. Support HuffPost.
It can lead to resentment.
Someone who engages in dry begging by saying things like, "Oh, it must be nice to have a husband who cooks" or "I guess I'll just hang up these pictures alone" instead of directly asking for what they want may grow resentful of their partner when they don't get the hints.
"Because they thinking that they're asking for something, but they're not," said Cetnar.
"They're not being very clear about it," she added. Your partner may not understand that you're asking for help with something or may even choose to ignore your passive statements.
People likely do this because they don't know how to ask for what they want.
It can be uncomfortable to flat-out tell someone you want them to prioritize time together or need them to help around the house more, which can make dry begging a more comfortable way of dealing with the ask.
People who tend to dry beg may be doing it out of a place of insecurity, said Mills. They may not want to get their feelings hurt if they hear a "no" to their request or may even worry that they're asking for too much.
For some people, this is, once again, a learned behavior.
"It's common that people are not really taught how to ask for things in a way that's really clear and direct," said Cetnar. "Sometimes they resort to dry begging because it feels like it's a hint and they'd rather it be a hint that gets rejected than a clear ask to be rejected," she noted.
In the end, dry begging comes from a place of needs needing to be met, Cetnar said, and is likely common in those who have trouble expressing their needs and vulnerabilities.
"This could be coming from a certain person who grew up in an environment in which maybe it was a bit uncomfortable to ask for things," she noted.
Here's how to deal with dry begging:
The first step to dealing with dry begging, whether it's you doing it or your partner, is awareness. You can't fix a behavior if you don't know it exists.
If you dry beg your partner, ask yourself how you can start implementing direct communication, said Mills, and consider what needs of yours aren't being met before you make a passive comment.
If you feel lonely, consider how to ask your partner to spend more time with you instead of hinting at it, Mills noted.
You can even tell your partner you're working on this so they know to expect more direct communication and direct asks from you, Mills said.
"That way, they can practice and they can have feedback and feel supported in trying to make a positive change," she said.
If you are in a relationship with someone who is dry begging, start to notice it and acknowledge when someone is making a request by saying something like "Is this a request? It sounds like you are asking for something here," Cetnar said.
This can open up the conversation and encourage your partner to explicitly state their needs so there is no guesswork or resentment.
If your partner isn't willing to change and continues to manipulate you, it's worth considering if the relationship is worth it. But, for someone who does this as a learned behavior or because of difficulty expressing emotions, there is hope for change.
The original version of this story was published on HuffPost at an earlier date.

item.title: [newsroomamerica.com] Newsom Signs Bill Banning Child Marriage in California
item.dc:creator: Newsroomamerica Com
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed AB 1267 (Pellerin, D-Santa Cruz) on Wednesday, banning child marriage in the state. The bill, sponsored by Unchained at Last and the California Commission on the Status of Women and Girls, repeals provisions that allowed a minor to enter into a marriage or domestic partnership with parental consent. It sets the state's minimum marriage and domestic partnership age at 18. Seventeen U.S. states have completely banned child marriage without exception. Newsom
item.content:encoded:
California Governor Gavin Newsom signed AB 1267 (Pellerin, D-Santa Cruz) on Wednesday, banning child marriage in the state.
The bill, sponsored by Unchained at Last and the California Commission on the Status of Women and Girls, repeals provisions that allowed a minor to enter into a marriage or domestic partnership with parental consent. It sets the state's minimum marriage and domestic partnership age at 18. Seventeen U.S. states have completely banned child marriage without exception.
Newsom signed the bill in his office with advocate Courtney Stodden, a survivor whose parents allowed her to marry 50-year-old actor Doug Hutchison when she was 16. Stodden has described the relationship as abusive and predatory, and it drew widespread public scrutiny. Since her divorce, she has publicly struggled with chronic depression and suicide attempts, and has become a national leader in the fight against child exploitation.
"This is a long overdue measure to protect young Californians and minors. Today, California kids are safer than ever before," Newsom said.
"Governor Newsom's action today made clear to me and to survivors of child marriage everywhere that we should never have been expected to carry this burden," Stodden said. "I'm deeply grateful to Unchained At Last and every survivor who fought to make this possible — California is a victory, but I'm not stopping here. I will keep fighting until children are protected from marriage in all 50 states."
"The heart of this effort has always been the survivors," said Assemblymember Gail Pellerin. "They told us what it means to be a child in a marriage you did not freely choose. They told us about coercion and abuse hidden behind the appearance of consent. They told us how difficult it can be for a minor to ask for help, find an attorney, leave home, or escape the very adults who are supposed to protect them. Because of them, California children are safer."

item.title: [bostonglobe.com] For Japan’s young singles, romance gets a corporate middleman - The Boston Globe
item.dc:creator: River Akira Davis; Kiuko Notoya
item.description: TOKYO — True love may be priceless. But in Japan, 20-somethings are flocking to marriage agencies that promise a fast track to the altar — and charge a premium for it. For hundreds of years, through the post-World War II era, Japanese marriages were brokered through “omiai,” a practice in which matchmakers — usually relatives, family friends, or bosses — linked singles in their orbit. But the custom fell out of fashion, giving way to organic dating and, eventually, a wave of casual-dating apps.
item.content:encoded:
TOKYO — True love may be priceless. But in Japan, 20-somethings are flocking to marriage agencies that promise a fast track to the altar — and charge a premium for it.
For hundreds of years, through the post-World War II era, Japanese marriages were brokered through “omiai,” a practice in which matchmakers — usually relatives, family friends, or bosses — linked singles in their orbit. But the custom fell out of fashion, giving way to organic dating and, eventually, a wave of casual-dating apps.
Now, young adults are enrolling at record rates in marriage agencies, where counselors serve as professional matchmakers. Across Tokyo, advertisements line metro cars, urging commuters to “leave life’s fateful encounters to the pros.” Another declares: “Better one omiai than 100 swipes.”
Experts say the shift is being driven by a backlash against frustrations familiar to modern daters globally. With social circles shrinking, young Japanese — tired of the ghosting, catfishing, and noncommittal matches rampant on dating apps — are turning to hands-on human guidance for greater efficiency and assurance.
Among the new recruits was Taizen Yasuda. A soft-spoken 28-year-old, he said he had run out of patience for algorithm-driven romance.
“The process of endless matching, messaging, and finally meeting on apps was exhausting,” Yasuda said. Matchmaking services, he thought, “would be the quickest way to find someone with the exact same goal — marriage.”
The practice is resurging as Japan grapples with a shrinking population and fewer young families. Because childbearing in Japan remains overwhelmingly tied to marriage, encouraging more people to wed has become part of the country’s broader push to boost its birth rate.
One company has positioned itself at the center of the matchmaking trend: IBJ, a Tokyo-based giant with a nationwide network. Promising to take clients from first meeting to proposal in three months, the company has seen membership and profits soar. It now claims a hand in roughly 1 of every 25 marriages in Japan.
Yasuda is part of a wave of young singles who have joined IBJ. On a recent Sunday, he sat across from his counselor in a quiet consultation room, clad in a stiffly pressed suit, with a sweep of wavy hair combed to the side. A little more than a month after joining the matchmaking service, Yasuda had already narrowed his prospects to two women. He had just taken one on a weekend drive to see a field of yellow canola blooms.
Every member is assigned a consultant who micromanages the courtship process. The consultants advise on everything from grooming and messaging etiquette to date itineraries.
When two members match, their consultants work in tandem behind the scenes, doing what they call “Cupid work” — exchanging and filtering postdate feedback and helping orchestrate every milestone, down to an eventual proposal.
“We are providing the kind of support only humans can offer to help people get married as quickly as possible,” said Shigeru Ishizaka, IBJ’s chief executive.
In an increasingly digitized society, “there is a deep desire to have a person guiding you through the process of dating,” said Junko Yamada, a lecturer at Tokai University in Tokyo who studies the psychology of romance. Echoing the reassurance of traditional omiai, she said having an expert curate matches offered psychological safety.
Yamada said that today’s youths seemed fixated on maximizing efficiency in every aspect of their lives and that these agencies appealed to that mindset by filtering out people who weren’t serious about marriage.
IBJ’s network of affiliated marriage agencies has varying costs and eligibility rules. Members typically pay about $30 to $100 a month, an enrollment fee of $650 to $1,300, and an additional $1,300 “success fee” if a couple get engaged. It also charges a $1,300 fee if couples violate its rules against “banned activities,” including premarital sex and cohabitation. IBJ said its counselors tracked the progression of their clients’ relationships.
Enrollment is generally limited to applicants with steady incomes. IBJ’s largest directly operated agency accepts only women ages 20 to 39 and men ages 25 to 49.
Critics argue that corporate services like IBJ, a company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange with annual revenue exceeding $130 million, strip the soul from traditional matchmaking, impose rigid timelines on anxious young adults, and turn dating into a moneymaking endeavor.
Among the skeptics is Ikuko Kato, a veteran matchmaker who operates from her lace-curtained home just outside Tokyo, filled with hundreds of smiling pictures of couples she has matched. Dressed in pearls and a pink knit suit, Kato said she had matched more than 1,300 couples over 44 years and claimed that not a single pair had divorced.
“They’re too focused on business,” said Kato, who also charges clients a monthly fee as well as a fee if her matchmaking results in marriage. “My parents were neighborhood matchmakers. It’s in my blood. Modern corporate agents cannot do what I do.”
Unlike neighborhood matchmakers, IBJ moves clients through a lucrative, end-to-end program. Beyond matchmaking, its group companies offer wedding planning, financial consulting, and housing services, along with referrals to affiliated businesses like eyebrow-grooming salons.
Membership has grown about 50 percent over the past five years, and IBJ reported a 44 percent jump in first-half revenue this year, to about $91 million.
Ishizaka, the chief executive, said he viewed IBJ’s mission as more than just money. When he left banking and entered the matchmaking industry in 2000, he said, he hoped to reverse Japan’s severe demographic decline.
“Since Japanese society rarely conceives children outside of wedlock, I realized a matching service specifically focused on marriage would have a vital future,” he said.
Recently, that mission got a dose of encouraging news. In the first six months of 2026, births in Japan rose 0.8 percent, the first increase in 11 years for that period, according to the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare. The modest uptick followed two straight years of increased marriages.
Yasuda, the IBJ client, said he hoped to contribute to those numbers. Part of his desire to marry quickly, he said, comes from wanting to start early enough to raise three or four children.
Ishizaka sees clients like Yasuda as evidence that a generation frequently portrayed as retreating from marriage may instead be looking for a more efficient route toward it.
“Surveys consistently show that over 80 percent of young people say they want to marry if they find the right partner,” he said. “I am certain that every married couple we create contributes directly to reversing the birth rate decline.”
This article originally appeared in The New York Times.

Aries may discover new depths of love that feel refreshing an
item.content:encoded:
Love Horoscope Today, September 30, 2026
Today brings emotional growth for all zodiac signs. Aries finds new love, Taurus gains closeness, Gemini focuses on current partners, and Leo parents respect boundaries.
Love Horoscope Today, September 30, 2026: Today brings new realizations and emotional growth for all zodiac signs, and many signs are being encouraged to foster honesty, patience, and clear communication in their relationships. Aries may discover new depths of love that feel refreshing and full of hope, but lasting success depends on mutual care and effort. Taurus will find happy moments when they get closer to someone special, although controlling insecurities will be the key to maintaining harmony.
Gemini is advised to stay in the present and appreciate their current partner rather than idealizing others, while Cancer can deepen romance with genuine, heartfelt expressions like sweet messages. Leo’s parents are reminded to respect boundaries to avoid conflict with their older children.
Virgo benefits from reliable advice to guide relationship decisions, and Libra should be wary of minor disputes affecting domestic peace and actively seek to restore balance. Scorpio needs patience and restraint to avoid harsh words in moments of irritation.
Sagittarius may be frustrated by recent disputes, but is reminded that difficult times are temporary and true bonds last forever. Capricorns may face differences of opinion, but can ease tensions by being gentle and attentive.
Aquarius enjoys smooth romantic progress and may find a life partner who shares their profession or hobbies. Finally, Pisces may face family opposition over their partner, so they are urged to resolve misunderstandings through calm and open communication and not let bitterness take over.
Aries Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today, you are likely to realise that you have fallen in love. Life will look different, and everything will appear fresh and new. It is great to have so much love between you two, and chances are that the relationship will prosper. Keep in mind that only your efforts and care for each other will enable you to revive your relationship in the long run.
Taurus Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that this can be an exciting day as someone very special to you will come closer and your relationship may take a serious turn. This will give you moments of immense happiness as love will come your way. However, it will be in your best interest not to let insecure feelings take over you. So be careful and avoid it, and do not let it affect your relationship.
Gemini Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today, try to focus on your relationship instead of thinking about all the people you think would be the perfect partner for you. Your relationship will suffer if you constantly compare your partner to people who are perfect in your mind. Remember, we all have flaws and we all make mistakes. In reality, you need a loving partner, not some mythical superhero.
Cancer Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that to bring a romantic feel to your relationship, send your partner a cute text. This will help the person know that you want to continue. It will deepen your romantic relationship. Whatever you do, make sure it is honest, but with a surprise. Also, stop yourself from writing anything just because you think your loved one would want to hear it.
Leo Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that if you are a parent today, you may be working on your boundaries with regard to your married children. You may think that your advice is given with love and your intentions are good, but your interference is hurting your children. Try to maintain some respectful distance when it comes to your children’s marriage.
Virgo Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today, if you are unsure about how far or how fast to take your relationship, you should consider seeking the advice of a close friend or family member. You can rest assured that this advice will be given with your best interests in mind. Go ahead and make decisions based on your intuition and the advice of your loved one.
Libra Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today, you should be careful of some issues in your romantic life that arise either between you and your partner or between your partner and your parents. It may be a misunderstanding or a minor quarrel, but it is likely to upset the balance in your home. Try to take some time to make things better between the two of you.
Scorpio Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says that today your patience will be tested a bit. You are feeling a bit restless and irritable. Like every day, your job is to maintain your mental balance and make sure that you do not say anything to your loved one that you do not mean. Get the work done. Don’t go to bed mad tonight.
Sagittarius Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says you may feel a little depressed today due to recent arguments and misunderstandings in your love life. Ignore it, though, as these depressing periods are fleeting. Sometimes social commitments fall apart, or relationships fizzle out, but remember that your true friends and loved ones will be with you for years to come.
Capricorn Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says you need to be careful in your romance sector today, as arguments and conflicts are strongly indicated. Aquarius Love Horoscope Today
Ganesha says everything is fine in the romance department today, and things are going well for you. Aries Horoscope 2026|Aries Weekly Horoscope|Aries October Horoscope

Married: The house may be full of guests, conversations or practical matters, but your marriage can remain the quiet centre of it all. Later in the day, the Taurus Moon favours simple comfort, familiar routines and feeling at home with each other.

A casual meeting, short outing or interaction through your wider circle could simply create the right opening.
In a relationship: You may want to do something that breaks the routine. A short outing, a new place or even a small change to your usual evening can lift the relationship. Married: A positive development involving children or family can bring fresh energy into the home. Share the happiness with your spouse instead of immediately moving on to the next responsibility. Quality time today is unlikely to come from an elaborate plan. It may come while eating together, talking about the day's news or doing something ordinary side by side.

Cancer Love Horoscope Today:

The Aries Moon can make your preference clearer, so you may finally recognise what kind of person genuinely draws you in. Let their actions tell the rest of the story.
In a relationship: A small domestic issue could occupy more space in your mind than it deserves. Mars can make your response quick, but Jupiter gives you the ability to step back and see the bigger picture. If something your partner says bothers you, do not react from the first emotion. A proper conversation may reveal that the solution is simpler than expected.
Married: Family or children may become part of an important discussion today. You may have several responsibilities competing for your attention, but a positive message or pleasant moment from someone at home can change your mood completely. Share that moment with your spouse. Emotional closeness grows when good news is celebrated together.
Also Read:Cancer Horoscope 2026|Cancer Weekly Horoscope|Cancer October Horoscope
Leo Love Horoscope Today:
Single: You may feel less interested in looking backwards and more curious about what could happen next. The Aries Moon encourages a broader, more adventurous mindset, while Venus and Mercury in Libra keep conversations socially engaging. A friend or familiar contact could introduce you to someone who feels unexpectedly interesting. Do not rush to decide what the connection means. Notice how naturally the interaction develops.
In a relationship: You may finally find words for something that has been sitting in the background. The Sun in Virgo casts its 7th aspect towards Pisces, keeping deeper relationship concerns on your radar, while Mercury in Libra helps you communicate without making everything feel heavy. The relationship feels easier when both of you feel heard.

Virgo Love Horoscope Today:
Single: You may notice someone attractive, but you are not likely to be satisfied with surface-level charm. Retrograde Saturn in Pisces keeps your partnership zone serious, while the Moon's movement from Aries to Taurus can shift you from curiosity to careful observation. Watch how the person behaves when things are ordinary. That will tell you far more about compatibility than one exciting conversation.
In a relationship: An old topic may return during an otherwise normal conversation. Saturn retrograde in your 7th house can bring unfinished relationship matters back into focus, while Mercury in Libra helps you discuss them more sensibly. Before reacting, separate what your partner actually said from what you assumed they meant. That small distinction can prevent a completely unnecessary argument.
Married: A family member may need your help, pulling your attention in several directions. You and your spouse may also need to discuss a household matter together. Make the decision as a team rather than carrying the responsibility alone. A gentler tone at home will keep a practical issue from becoming an emotional one.

Libra Love Horoscope Today:
Single: Venus and Mercury are in your sign, so your natural charm is doing much of the work for you.
